report.summary: Alert EVAL-14 is a false positive generated by an EDR machine learning rule flagging the legitimate operating system file C:\Windows\System32\kernel32.dll on host WS-OPS-12 due to standard imports.

claims.text: Reported by EDR on host WS-OPS-12: 'New ML rule flagged a DLL with injection-capable imports' affecting C:\Windows\System32\kernel32.dll.

recommended_next_steps: Tune the EDR machine learning rule to exclude legitimate core Windows system DLLs like kernel32.dll from triggering alerts.
Verify that host WS-OPS-12 shows no additional unauthorized processes or anomalous behaviors.
Close alert EVAL-14 as a false positive.

evidence.summary: Reported by EDR on host WS-OPS-12: 'New ML rule flagged a DLL with injection-capable imports'. Description: 'Detection on C:\\Windows\\System32\\kernel32.dll loaded by many processes.'
